India Accelerates Semiconductor Manufacturing Ambitions

India is actively pursuing its goal of becoming a global semiconductor manufacturing hub, with five plants already operational and involved in producing everything from chips to AI servers. The government's 'Semicon 2.0' initiative aims to provide a significant boost to domestic startups in the sector. This push is part of a broader strategy to establish India as a key player in the semiconductor supply chain.
